Ad slides: res://assets/signage/ads/ (192x96 PNGs; a folder of numbered frames is an animated slide). playlists: per-screen lists.

playlists._note: Per-screen playlists: set a screen's playlist in the World Painter. Entries play in order: an ad slide name from assets/signage/ads (wildcards like kitsune_*), "text:..." for a line of copy, "feed:<feed>" to mix in a whole feed (propaganda, news, stats...).
